data.name: MAM (ER–mitochondria contacts)
data.description: Mitochondria-associated ER membranes: a signalling platform distinct from the lysosome.
data.description_beginner: Where two organelles touch and talk.

studies.title: mTOR complex 2-Akt signaling at mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membranes (MAM) regulates mitochondrial physiology
studies.authors: Betz C; Hall MN et al.
studies.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: mTORC2-Akt signalling localizes to mitochondria-associated ER membranes to regulate mitochondrial function.

relations.mechanism: mTORC2–Akt signalling localises to mitochondria-associated ER membranes and regulates mitochondrial physiology from there.
relations.mechanism_beginner: mTORC2 signalling also happens at a specific contact point between mitochondria and another cell structure – proof this pathway works at more than one location in the cell.
relations.boundary: Biochemical fractionation and imaging in cell lines; the functional contribution relative to plasma-membrane mTORC2 is not quantified.
